server_description: Query BooksOntology, the live book performance map in Fabric IQ, as the signed-in user. Ask exactly one question about the rows of one entity, with each value in quotes, returning the entity's key and the properties you need. Pick the entity by need. What needs attention: Which TitleSignal rows have the IsMaterial value "Yes"? Return each SignalId, TitleName, SignalType, Headline, OpportunityAtRiskGbp and RecommendedOption. A title's options, their costs or the recommendation: Which DecisionOption rows have the TitleName value "<title>"? Return each OptionId, OptionName, IsRecommended, InvestmentGbp, RevenueProtectedGbp, RemainingRiskGbp, ArrivalDays, KeyAssumption and PrimaryRisk. A title's signals: TitleSignal; its sales and momentum: TitlePerformance (key TitleId); campaigns: Campaign (CampaignId); reprint requests: ReprintRequest (RequestId); print terms: Edition (EditionId). Copy values as returned, and cite each row with its own marker, by entity and key. Read-only.
